dispositions.explanation: The replacement preserves the combined minimal-envelope and delayed-redelivery contract, corrects the inherited description by recording that the envelope contains only message and messageType while the payload carries CorrelationId, asserts the exact scheduled delay and both delivery counts, and advances the real in-memory delay provider without wall-clock measurement.

productCorrection.behavior: Delayed delivery now enters the asynchronous provider call synchronously through registration instead of deferring registration to an untracked Task.Run.
productCorrection.reason: Under the complete UnitArchitecture load, virtual time could advance before the delayed operation was registered, leaving a correctly configured redelivery pending for real time.
